lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Lip fold base|lip, about 90.6 deg, folds down. Sections at 25/50/75% put the line on the outer arc apex within 0.04-0.12 mm (inner arc about 1.9 mm inboard). It runs the full 373 mm of the lip edge. Close-ups and the 12 global views agree.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Tall end flange (y+ end, lip side), about 90.4 deg. The sections show the line on the outer arc within 0.04 mm. In the close-up the line runs from the relief notch to about 5 mm short of the lip-corner end of the flange root, which is about 90% of the visible root of about 50 mm.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: Inclined tall end flange (y- end), about 110 deg. Although the pair uses the inner skin, the 25/50/75% sections put the line on the outer arc apex within 0.01-0.11 mm. It runs from the relief notch to near the lip-corner curl, about 44 of about 49 mm of root.

lines.label: B4
lines.reason: 30 mm tab (y- end), about 90 deg. The outer arc is only partly scanned, but the sections put the line on the outer-most arc points within 0.01 mm. The close-up shows the line spanning the full tab root, from the relief notch to the tapered base edge.

lines.label: B5
lines.reason: Inclined tab (y+ end), about 65.5 deg. The sections put the line within 0.06-0.19 mm of the outer arc, with a lateral shift of at most about 1 mm along the round arc, which still sits on the apex region. It spans the tab root from the relief notch to the base edge. Wide sections show the base next to the tab is straight to within under 15 deg, so the roughly 10 deg sag in strips 21/22 is not a bend.
